claim: Breitbart News reports that the daughter of Delaware Democratic Senator Chris Coons and seven other underage girls were featured on Hunter Biden's laptop.
justification: High-confidence evidence (0.90) from both fact-checks indicates that no law enforcement agencies, court documents, or credible news organizations have confirmed the presence of images of Senator Coons' daughter or other minors on Hunter Biden's laptop. The purported forensic analysis by CyLabs is low-confidence (0.10) and likely fabricated. Although evidence suggests Breitbart News published a report making this claim, the absence of any authoritative verification or corroboration refutes the substantive content of the claim about underage girls being featured on the laptop.
